name: Dynamic Island
description: iPhone-style island that morphs between live activities: ring/silent, timer with rolling digits, recording, music, plus call, notification and custom content.

inspiration.author: Apple (iPhone Dynamic Island), studied via Skiper UI skiper2

props.name: view
props.description: Activity to show; changing it morphs the island.

props.name: timerSeconds
props.description: Countdown length for the timer view.

props.name: children + size
props.description: Custom content with its own size.
